facts.value: The International Office of Economics is the central point of contact for all questions regarding studying abroad. The team of the International Office also supports guest students from international partner universities who come to study in Frankfurt.
For information on the recognition of examination achievements and the Learning Agreement, please contact the examination office.
Wednesday 9 - 11 AM, RuW 1.214 consultation hour. The consultation hour is cancelled until 9.9.26. During this time, please contact via email at international@wiwi.uni-frankfurt.de.
Please send your proposed appointment times to arrange a meeting outside of the open consultation hour.
Student assistants are also available for support. Please arrange an appointment via email.
